A fresh, separately painted production sprite for the Restoration druid crest. Image 1 is the installed crest, ONLY a composition, motif and paint-style reference. Extra images if supplied show specific details of that crest. Paint just the named object(s), whole from attachment to tip, including all the volume normally occluded. Real transparent alpha outside and through openings, ample transparent margins on all sides. Front-on orthographic. World of Warcraft hand-painted UI: chunky faceted forms, confident broad warm light planes from upper left, cool dark hue-shifted folds, crisp readable contour, selective fine engraving, rich restrained colour; strong three-value read at 162x216. Avoid grain, mosaic surface noise, hairline filigree, overly polished material, clone symmetry, UI labels or staged scene. Internal contact shadows within one physical object are welcome. External contact shadows between other layers will be composed separately; no ghost silhouettes of missing objects.
Paint ONE continuous slim rear shield/backdrop. Crown: a shallow pointed dark walnut plaque with chunky bevel, blank face for a separately applied crescent. Center: deep forest-green leaf-textured recessed shield, also blank, simple broad botanical facets, dark edges under the crown. Keep the upper side rails narrow and recessed to leave space for separate mossy boughs and inner crown leaves. LOWER HALF is important: build a living understory with two unequal fans of serrated sap-green leaves, deep green and chartreuse, curling around both flanks and into crevices. The bottom ends in a broad-shouldered tapering ROOT MASS. These are clearly underground roots: DAMP dark umber and cool soil-purple, compressed in places, knuckles, earth-stained elbows; one overlapping thick offset root on the left dives BACK, smaller irregular rootlets split and snake on the right. A single long tapered taproot ends the emblem. Some negative spaces between rootlets. Asymmetric and substantial, emphatically no woven golden rope, bright cinnamon branches, regular pretzel braid or symmetrical horns in the roots. 2 or 3 broad lit edges so the dark roots read. Main ratio about 0.55:1 framed by empty alpha; keep a solid center behind future medal and sprout, no imprints. No bracers, sprout, medallion, charms, carved moon, top/outer canopy, purple leaves, feather or horizontal golden belt: those are other pieces. Only the complete independently drawn backplate, basal greenery and soil roots.

Only TWO slender carved hanging charms, shown very large on transparent alpha side by side and separate. Match these little S-shaped ROOT-TALISMANS hanging left and right of the reference medallion; study the close-up. An important technical feature: each charm has ONE TINY slender open J pin at its very top, not a large loop. Golden amber heartwood rubbed luminous at the lip with deep burned-umber edge shade, broad smooth Warcraft bevels. The spiral body is the focus, the upper J pin a small practical detail. No rings, no closed eye, no strap, no gold band, no chain links, no bough, no medallion. Objects extend naturally from top to bottom, all edges visible.
